==Enemies==
'''Breaker''' may refer to these enemies:
*[[Breaker]], a blue Breaker enemy spawned by the [[Breaker2]] upon its death
**[[Breaker/Advanced Stats]]
*[[Breaker2]], a green Breaker enemy that spawns the [[Breaker]] upon death and is spawned by the [[Breaker3]] upon its death, replacing the [[Mystery]] in any map with the [[Enemies Beta]] modifier active
**[[Breaker2/Advanced Stats]]
*[[Breaker3]], a red Breaker enemy that spawns the [[Breaker2]] upon death and is spawned by the [[Breaker4]] upon its death
**[[Breaker3/Advanced Stats]]
*[[Breaker4]], a purple Breaker enemy that spawns the [[Breaker3]] upon death, replacing the [[Mystery Boss]] in any map with the [[Enemies Beta]] modifier active
**[[Breaker4/Advanced Stats]]
